summary: Dashboard Redesign Frontend Testing - Complete. All 6 new dashboard sections verified working correctly. The redesigned dashboard includes: 1) Greeting + Quick Pulse stats (4 stats showing personalized greeting and metrics), 2) Today's Actions (split view with Follow-ups Due and Needs First Outreach), 3) School Spotlight (horizontal scrollable cards with 'Next step' text and 'Browse Schools' dashed card), 4) Pipeline Snapshot (vertical bar chart with 6 status counts), 5) Recent Activity feed (timeline with colored dots and time-ago format), 6) Coming Up events section with date-box layout. All navigation links, onboarding checklist, and mobile responsiveness working correctly.

issues: Greeting shows 'there' instead of personalized name - this is expected behavior when athlete profile is not complete (firstName fallback)

Onboarding checklist visible with 4 steps (profile, schools, gmail, events)
Onboarding dismiss button works and persists via localStorage
Mobile responsive: 2-column pulse stats layout confirmed (grid-template-columns: 178px 178px)
